answer: TREM2+ microglia-like (TML) macrophages are identified by TREM2 and share an expression profile of P2RY12, CX3CR1 and OLFML3 with microglia-like macrophages from other developing organs; they also co-express immunomodulatory genes including immune-inhibitory receptors (e.g. CX3CR1) and regulators of IL-6 production (e.g. SYT11).
support_quote: We recently identified yolk-sac derived TREM2 + macrophages that share an expression profile (P2RY12, CX3CR1 and OLFML3) with microglia-like macrophages from other developing organs, such as the brain, prenatal skin and gonads 57,58
